In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of how speech technologies can contribute to the development of socially interactive robots.
the role of speech synthesis and recognition in social robotics, and with the importance of context in human robot collaboration.
the use of speech technology as a means to improve the social interaction between humans and robots.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the robot's voice has a more relevant effect on the user perception of the robot's capability when the interaction is direct and the user can assess the robot's capabilities while it is executing a given mission.
speech synthesis and recognition play a significant role in the perception of the user and in the acquisition of the context of the robots.
speech technology has a relevant role in human-robot collaboration.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
speech synthesis and recognition are important tools for the interaction between humans and social robots.
the use of speech synthesis and recognition in social robots should not be considered as a mere technological issue but rather as a social one.
the role of synthetic speech is important for human robot interaction, but it is not the same in all the different situations and scenarios that can be considered.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the robot's speech is an important social cue for the user, especially in a single robot interaction scenario.
speech synthesis and recognition are essential components in human robot interaction and that they should be considered as such in the design of social robots.
, in order to achieve a more effective HRI, the speech technology should be considered from a more holistic point of view.
